summary: Phase 49.1 (GALÉRIA OBRAZOV + HLASOVÝ SONAR + TTS markdown-strip) fully verified end-to-end. Backend 7/7 PASSED (100%, 20.7s, pytest_phase49_1.xml). POST /api/agent/imagine {prompt:'small golden angel wing icon'} → 200 with image_base64 (valid PNG magic bytes, >5KB), saved_to_vault:true and doc_id. GET /api/vault/documents returns the new doc with source:'jarvis_art' + content_type:'image/png'. GET /api/vault/documents/{doc_id}/file returns PNG bytes. DELETE /api/vault/documents/{doc_id} → 200, and the protected pre-existing doc f1b50e9e705042fe92005b801de2cfc7 is left untouched. Regressions all green: /api/agent/search {query:'test'} → 200 degraded:true (blank PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, gpt-5.4 fallback — EXPECTED), /api/agent/chat 'Ahoj' → 200 reply, /api/voice/tts with markdown/link body → 200 url (markdown stripping is client-side in /app/frontend/src/voice.ts as designed). Frontend (mobile 390x844): founder-bypass-btn logs in → /vault renders vault-screen → GALÉRIA OBRAZOV · JARVIS section visible with art-thumb-f1b50e9e705042fe92005b801de2cfc7 → tapping thumbnail opens doc-preview-image full-screen modal (golden triangle emblem rendered correctly) → doc-preview-close dismisses it. The pre-existing art doc does NOT also appear in the file-card list below (locator count = 0 for doc-{id}) — art/files split by source:'jarvis_art' works correctly. Jarvis regression: jv-mode-sonar text question returned reply with expected '...offline...chýba Perplexity kľúč...' notice; jv-mode-chat 'Ahoj' returned watermarked Slovak reply; jv-back returned to '/'. IMAGINE→vault chip UI flow was skipped intentionally per the optional/long note in the review request (image generation ~10-30s per call and the backend end-to-end is already covered by the pytest suite). Code-review of viaVoice sonar branch in /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx:207-212 confirmed: Onyx TTS speaks reply + announces citation count with Slovak grammar (1: 'jeden overený zdroj', 2-4: 'N overené zdroje', 5+: 'N overených zdrojov'); TTS in /app/frontend/src/voice.ts:61-68 strips markdown ```code```, [text](url) → text, raw URLs, and *_#`>| symbols before speaking — spec satisfied. No dead buttons or red screens observed.

jarvis.tsx sonar viaVoice branch announces citation count with correct Slovak declension (1/2-4/5+). No fallback if res.citations is undefined besides ||0 — fine.
agent.py /api/agent/imagine correctly returns 400 (Slovak) when OpenAI safety rejects the prompt; uses run_in_threadpool for the blocking put_object_sync — non-blocking. Good.
